display.title: Adar Rishon: Reasons to Increase in Joy
display.summary_short: On Rosh Chodesh Adar Rishon, Uncle Yossi explains why we increase in joy and gives three great reasons every Jew can always be happy.
display.summary_long: A short talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show, aired on Rosh Chodesh Adar Rishon in a leap year, which has two months of Adar. Our Sages teach that when Adar begins we increase our joy. We are meant to serve Hashem with joy all year, because the Shechinah rests only where there is simcha, and Adar asks us to add even more. Uncle Yossi gives three reasons to be happy: every Jew has a neshamah that is truly a part of Hashem, as we say each day, 'Ashreinu, how fortunate we are'; we have the Torah, whose mitzvos are Hashem's own will; and, as the Rambam teaches, we pray to Hashem alone, who listens to every prayer. The greatest joy of all will be the coming of Moshiach and the third Beis HaMikdash. He looks ahead to Purim, which celebrates Haman's downfall, and prays that we celebrate it with Moshiach in Eretz Yisroel.
display.lesson: Serve Hashem with joy, and in Adar add even more joy: we have a neshamah, the Torah, and a Father in heaven who hears our prayers.

date.note: 'It's already Rosh Chodesh Adar... the first one is today'; aired in episode 514 (Rosh Chodesh Adar I 5752).

sources_cited.note: Cited: we pray only to Hashem for all our needs.
